fields.name: research_id
fields.notes: sha256(production id)[:16]. Deterministic but not reversible from this dataset alone; replaces the production id/listing_number, which are not carried into this dataset.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.notes: Constant 'ps-dataset-20260930-v001' — which raw snapshot this row was derived from.

fields.name: advertised_price_paise
fields.notes: TARGET. Advertised/listing price in paise. This is NOT a verified completed transaction price — see governance/data-card-v1.md. Rows without a usable price (price_status != 'NUMERIC' or price_paise NULL) were dropped before this dataset was built (2 of 1737 raw rows).

fields.name: built_area_sqft
fields.notes: Normalised from property_listings.built_area (+ built_area_unit); the 1 sqm-denominated row was converted at 1 sqm = 10.7639104167 sqft. 0% missing.

fields.name: bathrooms
fields.notes: ~33.7% missing (586/1737 raw rows; proportionally similar in the 1735-row processed set).

fields.name: latitude_rounded
fields.notes: Latitude rounded to 2 decimal places (~1.1km grid) for privacy. Original exact latitude exists only in the raw snapshot (data/raw/), which is itself gitignored and not distributed. Use canonical_area_key/canonical_area_name as the primary location signal; request the raw snapshot only if an experiment specifically needs finer resolution and can justify it.

fields.name: longitude_rounded
fields.notes: Same treatment and caveat as latitude_rounded.

fields.name: canonical_area_key
fields.notes: Canonical Area identity (public.areas.area_key), not free-text locality.

fields.name: provenance_seller_type
fields.notes: Constant 'dealer' for 100% of this cohort. Kept as audit/provenance context, NOT a default predictive feature — see governance/data-card-v1.md limitations. A model trained naively on this column would learn nothing generalisable, since it never varies in this snapshot.

fields.name: provenance_trust_tier
fields.notes: Constant 'D' for 100% of this cohort. Same caveat as provenance_seller_type.

fields.name: provenance_created_at
fields.notes: All rows share one bulk-load timestamp (2026-07-02T20:27:06.444759Z). Do NOT use as a listing-age or recency feature — it reflects when this data was loaded into production, not when any listing was organically created.

fields.name: provenance_updated_at
fields.notes: Spans a few hours after created_at (bulk-load + resolution pass). Same caveat: not organic update activity.

dropped_from_raw.name: id / listing_number
dropped_from_raw.reason: replaced by research_id to avoid trivial production linkage

dropped_from_raw.name: price / price_unit
dropped_from_raw.reason: superseded by advertised_price_paise, the canonical field

dropped_from_raw.name: price_status
dropped_from_raw.reason: used only as a filter (NUMERIC + non-null price_paise); not needed downstream once filtered

dropped_from_raw.name: status / listing_purpose / is_valid / is_duplicate / archived_at
dropped_from_raw.reason: constant by cohort construction (LIVE / sale / true / false / NULL) — no information content in this dataset

dropped_from_raw.name: area_label
dropped_from_raw.reason: free-text locality; canonical_area_key/canonical_area_name is the documented preferred identity
